config.rationale: Tokenization ablation: fixed 7x7 patch embedding (28/7=4, yielding 16 tokens of dim 64) vs. the scheduled compact_transformer's learnable convolutional tokenizer. This isolates whether the conv tokenizer's adaptive receptive field provides a measurable advantage over a simple linear projection at 28x28. hidden=64 is divisible by num_heads=4 (64/4=16). 2 transformer blocks with mlp_ratio=4 keeps parameters under ~1M. Lower LR (3e-4) and decoupled weight decay (0.05) follow transformer training best practices to avoid attention collapse. Mean pooling over 16 tokens feeds the classification head. Label smoothing 0.1 prevents overconfidence on 9 classes. hflip + contrast augmentation mirrors the scheduled config for fair comparison. This candidate directly tests whether learnable tokenization matters at this resolution.
